projects.title: Vanilla JavaScript Weather App & Dynamic API Integration
projects.description: Build an interactive client-side weather forecasting application utilizing modern HTML5 semantic markup, CSS Grid/Flexbox layouts, asynchronous Fetch API calls, and resilient DOM update handling.
deliverables: Semantic HTML5 interface with responsive CSS stylesheet
Asynchronous JavaScript module handling HTTP fetch, JSON parsing, and error status handling
User city input validation and local storage persistence for recent queries
evidenceRequirements: Clean repository structure with separated concerns (HTML, CSS, JS)
Demonstrated asynchronous error handling for network timeouts and 404 responses
README with local setup instructions and architectural overview

projects.title: Accessible Modular Task & Todo Application
projects.description: Construct an accessible, state-driven task management application emphasizing keyboard navigation (WCAG a11y), clean state mutations, and resilient browser event delegation.
deliverables: ARIA-compliant semantic HTML markup for screen readers and keyboard tab navigation
State management module supporting task creation, toggle, filtering, and deletion
Persistence layer utilizing localStorage with schema serialization
evidenceRequirements: Working source code demonstrating event delegation and state immutability
Accessibility audit documentation (WCAG 2.1 AA compliance test)
Automated unit tests for core state reducer functions

projects.title: Enterprise Component Platform: Testing, State & Web Security
projects.description: Engineer an enterprise-grade client-side application featuring modular component architecture, automated unit/integration test suites, strict CSP/XSS defense, and performance-budgeted bundle optimizations.
deliverables: Modular React/TypeScript component hierarchy with strongly-typed properties and decoupled state stores
Comprehensive automated test suite (Jest/Vitest & Testing Library) verifying user workflows and edge cases
Client security configuration mitigating XSS, prototype pollution, and CORS configuration
Lighthouse performance optimization report demonstrating 90+ Core Web Vitals score
evidenceRequirements: Production-ready Git repository with CI test automation workflow
Documented Architectural Decision Records (ADR) detailing state architecture and security controls
Automated test coverage report exceeding 80% on core business components

projects.title: Relational B-Tree & Disk Storage Engine Prototype
projects.description: Develop a lightweight relational storage engine implementing a pager, B-tree node serialization, disk persistence, and a basic SQL token parser.
deliverables: Storage pager handling fixed-size memory page allocation and disk synchronization
B-Tree index implementation supporting search, insertion, and page splitting
REPL interface accepting SQL schema definition and INSERT/SELECT commands
evidenceRequirements: Source code verifying disk page flush invariants and pointer validity
Unit test suite verifying tree balancing, duplicate handling, and bounds checking
Memory profiling benchmarks confirming bounded heap utilization

projects.title: High-Throughput In-Memory Key-Value Caching Daemon
projects.description: Build an asynchronous in-memory caching daemon supporting Redis-compatible serialization, TTL expiration policies, LRU eviction, and non-blocking TCP socket polling.
deliverables: Non-blocking socket event loop handling concurrent client connections
TTL expiration engine and active/passive LRU memory eviction algorithms
Serialization parser supporting GET, SET, DEL, and EXPIRE commands
evidenceRequirements: Source code verifying thread safety or single-threaded event-loop guarantees
Concurrency stress test verifying zero race conditions under concurrent client traffic
Technical writeup detailing eviction trade-offs and latency benchmarks

projects.title: Production-Grade Resilient Order & Inventory Service
projects.description: Engineer a distributed, high-concurrency order and inventory management service featuring idempotent REST APIs, strict relational transaction isolation, JWT token rotation, and distributed rate limiting.
deliverables: Documented OpenAPI REST endpoints with idempotency keys and ETag optimistic concurrency
PostgreSQL schema with foreign key constraints, composite indexing, and EXPLAIN execution analysis
Automated test suite (unit + integration with test doubles/mocks) exceeding 80% coverage
Stateless JWT authentication service with refresh token rotation and RBAC
System architecture diagram and rate limiting middleware returning standard HTTP 429
evidenceRequirements: Production-ready Git repository with modular architecture and clean commits
Automated CI test pipeline passing all unit and integration tests
Architectural Decision Records (ADR) analyzing transaction isolation and concurrency trade-offs

projects.title: Transactional Exploratory Data Analysis & Data Wrangling
projects.description: Perform comprehensive data auditing, cleaning, and exploratory analysis on an uncurated transactional dataset to detect anomalies, reconcile discrepancies, and quantify underlying distributions.
deliverables: Jupyter / Python notebook documenting data cleaning pipeline (handling nulls, typing, deduplication)
Exploratory statistical profiles evaluating skewness, kurtosis, and correlation matrices
Cleaned, normalized dataset export ready for analytical modeling
evidenceRequirements: Executable notebook with clear markdown markdown explanations for each wrangling step
Data validation assertions verifying record integrity and constraint compliance
Visual distribution plots (box plots, histograms, heatmaps) illustrating findings

projects.title: Relational Customer Cohort Analysis & SQL Retention Modeling

deliverables: Production SQL script repository with parameterized analytical queries
Cohort retention heat matrix exported to auditable spreadsheet model
Query execution plan documentation detailing index utilization and join optimizations
evidenceRequirements: Formatted, comment-annotated SQL queries demonstrating advanced windowing and aggregation
Validation check queries confirming mathematical consistency of cohort retention sums
Spreadsheet workbook utilizing structured tables and dynamic lookup formulas
